clues.text: David's most famous psalm begins by calling the LORD this, so that he shall not want.
Jesus called Himself the good one of these, who lays down His life for the sheep.
Jesus said the Son of Man will divide the nations the way this person separates sheep from goats.
Before facing Goliath, David put five smooth stones into a bag named for this job.
When Jesus stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He pitied them as sheep without one.
On the way to the Mount of Olives, Jesus quoted Scripture: strike this one, and the sheep will scatter.
Isaiah says the Lord GOD tends His flock like this, gathering the lambs in His arms.
